name: Triceratops
descr: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.

data.motivesAndTactics: Eat ferns, move in herds for protection, patrol the watering hole

features.name: Leathery Hide
features.text: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can **mark any number of Stress** instead of an equal number of HP.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take **5d6** physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.text: **Mark a Stress** to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal **3d10** direct physical damage.
